description: Na₃CoF₆ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent CoF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-40°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.19-2.25 Å. Co is bonded to six F atoms to form CoF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-40°. There are two shorter (1.85 Å) and four longer (1.86 Å) Co-F bond lengths. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Co atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Co atom.
